data.context: In WIPO’s *Global Innovation Index 2026* (2026), Appendix IV explains the data and geocoding methods used in the innovation-cluster methodology. It describes the 2021–2025 worldwide PCT patent dataset and the 2020–2024 worldwide scientific-article and venture-capital datasets, and how inventor, author and deal-location addresses were matched to cities using ESRI ArcGIS and GeoNames.
